result.summary: All 13 ISS-202 tests fail with PoolError.QueryFailed due to tenant context not being propagated to pool connections. Infrastructure (DB, migrations, schemas) is healthy. Fixed GBL-081 migration skip (was blocking migrations). Remaining issue: pool connections cannot find tenant-specific schema tables.

issues.description: All 13 ISS-202 tests fail when definition/store.zig attempts to create process definitions via connection pool. Error: PoolError.QueryFailed. Root cause: process_definitions table exists only in tenant_default schema (not public schema). Pool.acquire() should apply tenant context via applyRequestTenantContext(), but tenant_context thread-local is not initialized.
issues.recommendation: ORCH must dispatch ADHOC BACKEND-DEV to review tenant context initialization for integration tests. May require: (1) Pool pre-configuration, (2) TestHarness changes, (3) test code changes, or (4) build.zig module export updates.

issues.recommendation: Migration skip is permanent fix (this is a GBL global migration not needed for test environment).
